body.purpose: Primary interface and report reading copy.

status.purpose: Connection, run, and evidence state annotations.

shadows.name: assembly-lift
shadows.purpose: Temporary lift at the start of a newly filed report's settling motion; document surfaces otherwise have no resting shadow.

motion.name: docket-assembly
motion.purpose: Settles a newly filed report sheet from -8px and temporary shadow to rest.

motion.name: skeleton-pulse
motion.purpose: Pulses loading bars to 0.45 opacity at the midpoint.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses all animations and transitions when reduced motion is preferred.

components.name: Primary Docket Button
components.description: The authoritative action for opening or advancing a docket.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--moss); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--moss); color: #fff; font: 800 0.79rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.02em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #29473f; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Docket Field
components.description: The familiar native text-field treatment used throughout cover sheets and filters.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 5px; color: var(--ink); font: 750 0.79rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 7px 9px; border: 1px solid #83918d; border-radius: 2px; background: #f8faf9; color: var(--ink); font: 400 1rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field:hover { border-color: var(--moss); } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Docket Rail Navigation
components.description: A ruled, uppercase office index that keeps primary destinations visible.
components.html: New docketIndex
components.css: .ds-rail { min-height: 57px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--ink); font: 700 0.82rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-rail-link { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail-link:hover { color: var(--moss); } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Completed Status Stamp
components.description: An outlined state word that identifies an open or completed record without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-completed { display: inline-flex; padding: 4px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--moss); border-radius: 0; background: #f8faf9; color: var(--moss); font: 800 0.72rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Hold Signal Badge
components.description: A compact, explicitly named trade-signal badge using restrained amber.
components.css: .ds-signal-hold { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--amber); border-radius: 0; color: #77500c; background: transparent; font: 800 0.67rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.04em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-signal-hold:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-sr-only { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }

components.name: Cover Sheet
components.description: The bordered configuration document, visually distinct from open folios and ledgers.
components.html:
New research docket

Open an analysis

Set the instrument and review team.
components.css: .ds-cover-sheet { padding: 17px 19px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-top: 2px solid var(--moss); border-radius: 0; background: rgba(244, 246, 245, 0.78); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: none; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-cover-sheet h2 { margin: 4px 0 5px; font-size: 1.65rem; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-cover-sheet p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.45; } .ds-folio { color: var(--moss); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Filed Report Tab
components.description: The selected evidence index tab with an explicit filed state and completion dot.
components.css: .ds-report-tab { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 9px 7px; border: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--moss); border-radius: 0; background: #e1e7e4; color: var(--ink); font: 750 0.75rem/1.2 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-report-tab::after { content: ""; display: inline-block; width: 5px; height: 5px; margin-left: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--moss); } .ds-tab-state { display: block; font-size: 0.59rem; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-report-tab:hover { color: var(--moss); } .ds-report-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-report-tab:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Docket Assembly Sheet
components.description: The signature evidence arrival: a newly filed sheet settles briefly, then remains flat in the folio.
components.html:
Final memorandum

The completed evidence record settles into place.
components.css: .ds-assembly-sheet { max-width: 75ch; padding: 15px 9px 6px; color: var(--ink); background: #f7f8f7; font: 400 1rem/1.45 ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; animation: ds-assemble 180ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.25, 1); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-assembly-sheet h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-assembly-sheet p { margin: 0 0 11px; } .ds-assembly-sheet:focus-within { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; } @keyframes ds-assemble { from { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 12px 22px rgba(29, 37, 43, 0.18); } to { transform: none; box-shadow: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-assembly-sheet { animation-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
The interface behaves like an institutional research file assembled in public: cool archival stock holds charcoal ink, ruled divisions, graphite annotation, restrained docket amber, and deep moss marks of authority. Density is deliberate and legible rather than dashboard-like; the page shows the chain from configuration through evidence to decision without adopting a trading-terminal aesthetic.

Hierarchy comes from differentiated document roles. A bordered cover sheet contains configuration, the open folio gives reports a quieter reading field, and the pipeline and history index behave as ruled ledgers rather than repeated cards. Familiar inputs, buttons, links, tabs, tables, and status labels remain unmistakable inside that language.
keyCharacteristics: Cool archival surfaces with charcoal, moss, and restrained amber.
Square folios, fine rules, indexed tabs, stamps, and graphite annotations.
Flat-at-rest hierarchy with one brief assembly lift when evidence arrives.
Explicit state words, marks, and structure that never rely on color alone.
Compact institutional typography built from the system sans-serif stack.

rules.name: The Ink-and-Moss Rule
rules.body: Charcoal carries information; moss marks action, access, or settled evidence. Amber and red remain semantic exceptions, never ambient decoration.

rules.name: The State-Plus-Signal Rule
rules.body: Every status color is paired with a word, border, dot, or positional state so completion, waiting, reconnecting, failure, and trade signals remain understandable without color.

rules.name: The Indexed Voice Rule
rules.body: Uppercase, tracked type is reserved for folios, stamps, navigation, table headers, and state annotations; prose and report content remain sentence case.

rules.name: The Flat-at-Rest Rule
rules.body: Depth is structural, not decorative: use stock, rules, and document role at rest, and reserve shadow for the brief arrival of new evidence.

dos: Do differentiate cover sheets, open folios, and ruled ledgers through stock and border hierarchy rather than repeating one card treatment.
Do keep status words, marks, and semantic borders visible alongside color.
Do preserve 44px navigation and report-tab targets on compact screens and the shared 3px offset keyboard focus outline.
Do keep generated report text readable at no more than 75ch, with safe wrapping and local overflow for GFM tables and code.
Do use Docket Assembly only when a report newly becomes available, with immediate state change under reduced motion.
donts: Don't turn the surface-specific four/eight dashboard composition into a global layout mandate.
Don't add generic floating cards or resting drop shadows to document surfaces.
Don't spend amber or red as ambient decoration; they carry queued/reconnecting and failure/signal semantics.
Don't hide standard report tabs behind a bespoke visualization or communicate progress through animation alone.
Don't invent financial claims, performance decoration, or terminal-like market spectacle inside the research record.
